checks.description: Readiness checks run before opening a PR. All on by default (current behavior).

knowledge_check_enabled.description: Prompt to curate knowledge from the diff before opening a PR.

readme_check_enabled.description: Verify READMEs are updated for added/renamed/removed features.

version_bump_check_enabled.description: Verify plugin versions are bumped and in sync.

review_bot.description: Mention that triggers the automated PR review.

route.description: Review route: auto probes the bot and remembers a no-answer per repo; github always posts the mention; local goes straight to /swarm:review.

merge.description: Merge gate for repos without branch protection. /merge reads it from the base branch on the remote, never from the working tree.

require_approval.description: Refuse to merge without approving reviews on the head being merged.

on_head.description: Count only approvals of the exact head commit being merged.

exclude_author.description: The PR author's own approval does not count.

allow_bots.description: Count approvals by bot accounts (e.g. a GitHub Actions workflow). Bots skip the collaborator check, so a workflow the PR adds could approve it; list the bot in approvers to bound it.

approvers.description: If non-empty, only these logins count.

require_comments_addressed.description: Open review threads and unanswered PR comments block the merge outright instead of asking for an acknowledgement.
